title: Report: Korean telecom's alleged China ties triggered US block on Anthropic models
summary: Citing the Washington Post, Korea JoongAng Daily reported the White House weighed controls after a Korean telecom 'suspected of ties to China' appeared among Mythos 5 access holders; SK Telecom declined to comment.
reason: Explains the national-security rationale behind the Jun 12 controls (China-leakage fear plus an Amazon-reported jailbreak); deepens tech decoupling.

title: SpaceX agrees to buy Cursor for $60 billion in stock
summary: Days after its IPO, SpaceX (parent of xAI) agreed an all-stock deal for AI coding firm Cursor, aiming to 'build the world's most useful AI models' on its Colossus compute.
reason: Big acquisition consolidating a frontier lab, compute and a top AI app (rubric T2 up).

title: Z.ai releases open-weight GLM-5.2; CEO says China will match Fable 5 soon
summary: China's Z.ai (Zhipu) released MIT-licensed GLM-5.2, reported to beat GPT-5.5 on several coding benchmarks at a fraction of the cost; founder Jie Tang said a Chinese Fable-5-class model is coming sooner than Musk's Q1 2027 estimate.
reason: Strong open-weights model narrows gap with US frontier (rubric T2 down for F5). Release date given as Jun 13 by some outlets, Jun 16 by Tom's Hardware.

title: European Parliament votes to delay EU AI Act high-risk rules
summary: Parliament adopted the AI 'digital omnibus', pushing stand-alone high-risk obligations from Aug 2026 to Dec 2027 (embedded products to Aug 2028) while adding a ban on AI-generated CSAM and non-consensual intimate imagery.
reason: Major regulator softens and postpones its flagship regime (partial rollback); offset slightly by new prohibitions.
